sources.label: Council of the European Union, November 19–20, 2026
claims: Provisional agreement, dates, and review requirement
sources.evidence_excerpt: The agreement sets importer monitoring, reporting and verification at January 1, 2029, intensity reporting at August 5, 2030, and the Commission review by January 1, 2028. Formal adoption is still required.

sources.label: European Commission, Directorate-General for Energy, November 19, 2026
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Commission cited energy market strain linked to the Middle East conflict and said the postponement gives operators time to prepare.

sources.label: European Parliamentary Research Service, 2026
sources.evidence_excerpt: The briefing records Ambassador Andrew Puzder’s April 2026 criticism of the requirements and warning about their effect on energy supply.

sources.label: Reuters, November 19, 2026
sources.evidence_excerpt: Reuters reports industry concerns about contracting and quotes Charlie Riedl on the relief provided by the delay.

sources.label: Financial Times, November 19, 2026
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Financial Times reports sustained lobbying by the United States, Qatar and the oil and gas sector.

sources.label: Columbia University Center on Global Energy Policy, October 22, 2026
sources.evidence_excerpt: The researchers identify unfinished verification protocols, accreditation and harmonized penalty rules.

sources.label: Environmental Defense Fund Europe, Carbon Limits analysis
claims: Estimated direct monitoring, reporting and verification costs
sources.evidence_excerpt: The analysis estimates 0.03% to 0.6% of production value for the producer types studied.

sources.label: Regulation (EU) 2024/1787, Article 33
sources.evidence_excerpt: For legal persons the specified administrative fines may not exceed 20% of annual turnover in the preceding business year.

sources.label: Reuters, November 19, 2026, agreement coverage
claims: Independent confirmation of the two-year delay
sources.evidence_excerpt: Reuters reports the two-year postponement and the energy market disruption cited in support.
